description: This file defines a composable screen 'VoiceTabScreen' for an Android app using Jetpack Compose, handling voice input, microphone permissions, user interface elements for mic controls, speaker toggle, and displaying voice conversation bubbles. It references external ViewModel 'MainViewModel' and voice-related data structures, as well as Android and Compose UI components.

classes.name: VoiceTurnBubble
classes.description: A composable that displays a chat bubble for a voice conversation entry, distinguishing between user and assistant roles.

classes.name: VoiceThinkingBubble
classes.description: A composable that shows a 'thinking...' indicator with animated dots.

classes.name: ThinkingDot
classes.description: A composable that displays a small animated dot for the thinking indicator.

methods.name: hasRecordAudioPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to record audio.

methods.name: findActivity
methods.description: Recursively finds the Activity from a Context.

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Opens the app's settings page in system settings.
